description: Price WorldTrips Atlas Travel visitor insurance for a family (non-U.S. citizens traveling to the U.S.) at $50,000 or $100,000 coverage and a $0, $250, or $500 deductible ($500 is per traveler per certificate period) — a verified family base premium only when the pinned independent carrier rate card is valid and the website's family base total for identical inputs agrees with it to the cent. Returns per-traveler age-band daily rates, the family base total, and a prefilled compare link; otherwise an explicit needs_clarification, unsupported_composition, stale, price_discrepancy, or unavailable status plus the compare link. Family base premium in USD only (excludes applicable taxes/fees and optional coverages) — the carrier confirms final price and eligibility at checkout, and the tool never buys a plan or takes payment details. On a verified priced result, compare_page_url carries a stateless quote reference that automatically restores the exact matched WorldTrips Atlas Travel option in-row on /insurance/compare (omitting the page-wide deductible filter for $500 so other plans stay visible) and reads the live base premium on arrival — do not instruct manual selection. Only on an ineligible/unverified fallback is compare_page_url a prefilled family comparison without a verified quote reference: when inputs are complete and an Atlas family rate cannot be verified, tell the user to find Atlas Travel and select the requested deductible in the Atlas Travel row's Deductible control rather than the page-wide deductible filter, clearly distinguish the unverified site base price from both a rate-card-verified family base premium and the carrier's final checkout price, and do not add individual prices together as a substitute.

deductible.description: Deductible in USD. 0, 250, and 500 are the pinned Atlas Travel rate-card columns and return a rate-card-verified family base premium when the live rate card and website family base total agree. On a verified priced result, compare_page_url carries a stateless quote reference that automatically restores the exact matched Atlas Travel option in-row on /insurance/compare (omitting the page-wide deductible filter for $500 so other plans stay visible) and reads the live base premium on arrival.

destination_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 destination. Must be US for the verified Atlas America slice; omit and the tool asks instead of guessing.

end_date.description: Last day of coverage as YYYY-MM-DD; at least one day after start_date.

max_coverage.description: Coverage maximum in USD — only the pinned card columns are supported.

product.description: The only verified product: WorldTrips Atlas Travel (Atlas America).

residence_citizenship.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country all travelers share as residence AND citizenship. Must not be the US or a US territory; omit and the tool asks instead of guessing.

start_date.description: First day of coverage as YYYY-MM-DD; today (UTC) or later.

travelers.description: The family to price: exactly one self, at most one spouse, and up to five children. Ages are whole years on the coverage start date — no dates of birth.

age.description: The traveler's age in whole years on the coverage start date.
